summary: Steven Kotler is a bestselling author and the executive director of the Flow Research Collective, where he studies the science of peak performance. Hours disappear, everything else fades away, and the work seems to do itself.
takeaways: We also get into what frustration is really telling you when you’re learning, how play compares with practice, how to focus on work you’d rather not be doing, and how to think clearly when there’s more information than ever and fewer people checking it.
Kotler has spent decades studying flow, and he makes the case that it’s far more trainable than most people think.
